errors.invalid: Enter a valid start and end.
errors.order: The start must be before the end.
errors.future: The end cannot be in the future.
errors.tooLong: That range is longer than the retention limit.

stopped.title: Database is stopped
stopped.body: Metrics are not collected while the database is stopped. Start it to resume.

provisioning.title: Database is provisioning
provisioning.body: Metrics begin once the container is running.

failed.title: Provisioning failed
failed.body: The container never started, so there is nothing to measure.

restarting.title: Database restarted recently
restarting.body: Readings may show a gap while it comes back.

noData.title: No data yet
noData.body: No samples in this range. Samples arrive every few seconds once the database runs.

notCollected.title: Not collected
notCollected.body: This engine does not report this series yet.
